company.name: Love That Design
company.shortDescription: Love That Design is a global interior design platform that showcases the best of what the Design and Construction community has to offer.
company.description:
At  Love That Design, we provide resources to design and build your ideal space.

We help the design and construction industry win and deliver more work by showcasing their expertise on projects executed and enabling all the stakeholders in the value chain. By this, we are creating the largest design and construction community for customers globally. We do this through two offerings

1) Love That Design: Design platform connecting the interior design industry offering online and in-person engagement.

2) .STUDIO:  Workflow automation software that manages & tracks project resources from Pitch to Completion.

Unlike product aggregators and traditional SaaS providers, we offer a unique combination of industry engagement, data, and tools to create a self-managed and self-growing ecosystem.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $407,000, or 63.49% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,762,682 to $4,141,986, a 2.35x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 28 (-31 over 90 days) and market heat at 69 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
